verdict.rationale: Secureframe's vendor risk management feature keeps an active vendor inventory, kept current by SSO-based shadow-IT detection. It covers continuous monitoring of vendor security posture, recurring reviews scheduled by risk level with Jira/Slack tasks, and AI extraction of answers from vendor SOC 2 reports, all inside the platform rather than a spreadsheet. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of tracking each vendor's data access/data types, and independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor marketing).
